decisions.reason: Operator training is a low-cost service option that supports machine sales and builds on existing training capabilities, so keeping it open costs little.
A fourth rotary axis accessory is a cheap modular add-on that raises the value of the core milling platform, and keeping it on the market carries minimal cost.

Hybrid additive post-processing remains highly uncertain but strategically aligned with future-oriented digital fabrication, so the option is worth keeping open while its value resolves, though it is the most likely candidate for abandonment.
The high-speed CNC milling machine sits at the firm's core and was presented on a page of its own, so further commitment is justified rather than abandonment.
The automatic tool change system complements the core machines, was prominently presented, and is cheap to maintain within the modular system.
